title: Termination condition for token/cost budget
body:
### What feature would you like to be added?

Add a termination condition to stop a task execution from using too many tokens. 

Depends on https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/issues/4017

### Why is this needed?

Important to save money.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue as it involves managing token usage, which falls under "Token usage misconfiguration" in the LLM operation issues category, a component unique to agent systems.
